{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    scores_list = case.get('round_scores')
    targets = case.get('round_targets')
    forced = case.get('forced')
    if scores_list is None or targets is None or forced is None:
        raise ValueError('Missing required fields')
    if len(scores_list) != len(targets):
        raise ValueError('round_scores and round_targets length mismatch')
    if not scores_list:
        raise ValueError('No rounds')
    n_tokens = len(scores_list[0])
    if any(len(r) != n_tokens for r in scores_list):
        raise ValueError('Inconsistent token count across rounds')
    forced_set = set(forced)
    if any(idx < 0 or idx >= n_tokens for idx in forced):
        raise ValueError('Forced index out of range')
    active = list(range(n_tokens))
    history = []
    for i, (scores, target) in enumerate(zip(scores_list, targets)):
        forced_in_active = [idx for idx in forced if idx in active]
        forced_count = len(forced_in_active)
        if target < forced_count:
            raise ValueError(f'Target {target} < forced count {forced_count} at round {i}')
        if target > len(active):
            raise ValueError(f'Target {target} > active count {len(active)} at round {i}')
        candidates = [idx for idx in active if idx not in forced_set]
        candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda idx: (-scores[idx], idx))
        selected = candidates_sorted[:target - forced_count]
        new_active = sorted(forced_in_active + selected)
        active = new_active
        history.append(active[:])
    return {'history': history, 'retained_indices': active}"}
